description: List laws, decrees and decisions by date, newest first: for "everything published since January 2025" call with since "2025-01". The date is the publication date: the Official Gazette date, else the issue date (each entry's date, with gazette_number, gazette_date and gazette_issue_id). Recent texts come from machine readings of Gazette scans (ids from 2000000000, unofficial) because the Lebanese University's Centre lags about a year, so a recent period lists mostly those. since and until accept YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. kind narrows to one kind, in Arabic ("قانون", "مرسوم") or English ("Law", "Decree"). For the next page pass next_cursor as cursor (it is absent on the last page); total is the whole count. Not legal advice.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous answer; omit for the first page

kind.description: the kind of text, Arabic or English (e.g. "قانون" or "Law", "Decree")

since.description: first date, inclusive: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. "2025-01")

until.description: last date, inclusive: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD

name: list_legislation
title: List legislation by date
